mapper.sql: SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.type, n.publisher_id, n.status, n.view_count, n.publish_time, u.real_name AS publisherName FROM t_notice n LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = n.publisher_id

sql.if: AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: ORDER BY n.status DESC, n.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notice (title, content, type, publisher_id, status, view_count, publish_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{publisherId}, #{status}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notice SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_notice SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
